Broken Ranks Gameplay Preview - Dark Fantasy Isometric MMORPG
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be talking about an indie MMO RPG that aims to deliver an old school isometric RPG like experience called Broken Ranks, made by a small development team based in Poland, consisting of around 40 developers, broken ranks is an MMO RPG with Crpd inspirations and a turn based combat system. Initially released back in 2022, we got a chance to jump back in the game ahead of its global Android release, which is already out now, and this game is reminiscent of old games.
